text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Your letter's in good hands! One super
express delivery to the next
town over,
coming right up!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! I finished
collecting all the items for
delivery!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then we'll split up the letters and fulfill
the tasks that fall on the same
route! That
way we can knock out seventeen whole
tasks!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm a Courier, so I'll take the letters and
jobs that are the farthest out!
Teio, Turbo,
can you handle the stuff closer to home?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Nrrrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Turbo, that box looks really heavy! Do you
want me to take care of it
instead?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...I'm fine! You showed me the shortcut, so
all I have to do is run! The
heaviness is a
challenge... Hehe... And challenges fire me
up!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's Turbo for you. We're counting
on you! Let's meet back up
later!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If I tighten the bulb like this... that ought
to... There! The washer's
good as new!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well done, Taishin. You're really good
with your hands.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I am a Mechawork Engineer. And I
could increase the output
thanks to your
advice.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The manual I borrowed from the workshop
came in handy. Looking at
it side by side
with the actual machine helped immensely.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
By acquiring knowledge in this way,
perhaps we could apply it to our
airplane
research—

text_block_list.name: Bistro Server
text_block_list.text:
What's that about airplanes and research?

Oh, I recognize you. You were with the
young lady from the
workshop.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We're assisting her with her
research.

text_block_list.name: Bistro Server
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ahaha! Aw, you shouldn't take her
dream talk seriously! There's
no way a
hulking lump of metal can fly!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But she said she saw an airplane of steel
do just that.

text_block_list.name: Bistro Server
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you mean the test model the old
researcher made. That one did
fly for a bit,
but everything that came after ended in
failure.

text_block_list.name: Bistro Server
text_block_list.text:
He threw in the towel eventually, though,
and retired. I hope that girl
snaps out of it
and gets her feet back on the ground too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Excuse me?

text_block_list.name: Bistro Server
text_block_list.text:
We've got trains, ships, automobiles...
What use is an airplane? She's
a smart gal,
so she could easily get a job as an
automotive engineer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the word of caution. We'll take
our leave now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What's with her? Making fun of someone's
dream like that... "Get a
job as an
automotive engineer." Who the hell asked
her?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's probably only out of concern. Flight
tests come with risks, and
with the way our
friend works herself to the bone, the
concern is
warranted.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't give her an excuse to shoot
her mouth off! Saying "give
up" like it's the
simplest thing... It makes me so mad!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Getting a steel frame airplane into the air
is far from easy. I think
she's coming from a
place of care, telling her to choose
another path
before she gets hurt.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And I'm telling you, no one asked for her
opinion—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But she's not giving up. It's likely she can see her way clear to success. In other words, we have to get others to understand that by...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...showing them that it can work. That it is possible.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
We'll get her airplane flying and prove the
naysayers wrong!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's my goal as well. As if I'd take
that woman's warning to
heart.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh. You're angrier than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why wouldn't I be?
Well, given the
research funds we've collected, I think we
can
consider this part of the job done.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's about time we began helping with the
research in earnest. Would
you mind if we
stopped by the workshop? I want to
borrow some
research notes.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... H'llo! I got... those replacement machine parts you asked for!

text_block_list.name: Sewing Mill Worker
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! You're a lifesa—whoa, did you
carry that box by hand?! Why
didn't you
take a car?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm faster than any car! So? Where should I
put this? Just say the word
and I'll carry it
wherever!

text_block_list.name: Sewing Mill Worker
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you're a huge help! Then, could I
ask you to put it over there?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hello! I stacked the boxes of ingredients
you ordered out back. Could
you check
that it's all accounted for?

text_block_list.name: Bistro Waiter
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! Wait, you delivered all twelve
boxes by yourself?! And
you're already
done? I thought it'd take at least three
trips.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? I just carried them all at once.

text_block_list.name: Bistro Waiter
text_block_list.text:
Hoo-wee! You must have an amazing sense
of balance!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for entrusting your deliveries to us!
We've completed all your
requests!

text_block_list.name: Delivery Service Employee
text_block_list.text:
What? Already?! The delivery locations
were all over the place! Heck,
there was
even that one stop at the foot of the
mountain!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! It was just a hop, skip, and jump
across the rooftops! If you
have other
orders you want us to fill, then we'd be
happy to take care
of them!

text_block_list.name: Delivery Service Employee
text_block_list.text:
No, I think we're fine for now. But, wow,
you're just bursting with
vitality, aren't
you? How can you keep up that pep?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Actually, we're trying to put together
funds for research! For the steel
airplane!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
We're helping build a brand-new model!
Amazing, right?!

text_block_list.name: Delivery Service Employee
text_block_list.text: Airplane, you say?! You're seriously trying to make that death trap fly? Forget about it! One crash, and you're toast!

text_block_list.name: Delivery Service Employee
text_block_list.text:
I heard that after the prototype flopped,
one of the two developers
just gave up on
being a researcher entirely.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Gave up? You mean the plane's creator
did?

text_block_list.name: Delivery Service Employee
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I bet he got too scared to even look
at one of the contraptions.
He left the
broken remains of the aircraft in the field
where it
crashed.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! The wreckage is still there?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
This adjustment may take some more
time... Sorry for making you
wait.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's not a problem. I'll be reading past
research notes, so take your
time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I see. The body of the craft couldn't
handle the increase in internal
pressure, so
he changed the material... Ah, so that's
what this formula
means.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
He arrived at this material by recalculating
the output over and over.
Additionally, he
took great pains to compensate for any
issues that
cropped up during the test
flights...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Her teacher's belief in his success didn't
waver. He thought if he
could tackle every
problem as it arose, the plane would fly.
And
through trial and error, he got very
close to flying over the mountains!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
He achieved so much! ...We can't allow his
efforts to be in vain after
everything.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That airplane is the culmination of his
labor of love!
